formal_target_rows.claim: Shared ancestry strictly lowers declared finite-set dependency independence.
Execution is true exactly when selection and every frozen authority condition pass.
An explicit claim-state assertion creates no distinct claim-state assertion.
Recalled roots and declared descendants are blocked while unrelated nodes are not blocked solely by the recall relation.
Closed-interval robust pass and fail are disjoint and the classifier is complete and exact.
The frozen robust-dominance relation is irreflexive and transitive.
Frozen trajectory shortfall and marked violation span are nonnegative, and a nonnegative trace has zero shortfall.
The aftershock count cannot exceed the number of adjacent sample pairs.
Proof, selection, authorization, deployment, and observation require distinct witnesses.

nonvacuity_obligations: release_states_are_independent_nonvacuous constructs five distinct witnesses so proof, selection, authorization, deployment, and observation cannot collapse

robustness_kernel_v1_nonvacuous simultaneously instantiates strict common-parent loss, authority pass and advisory denial, all three interval states, strict robust dominance, nonzero trajectory shortfall, one aftershock, and recalled, descendant, and unrelated lineage cases
Every theorem statement, definition, and witness remains byte-for-byte semantically identical to the frozen source and statement contract

empirical_claims: Real dependency maps may omit common parents.
Declared uncertainty intervals may be uncalibrated.
Declared trajectory samples may not represent the real path.
A recorded authority lease may not be legitimate or current.
The broader kernel may or may not improve decisions in society, cybersecurity, architecture, infrastructure, or product design.

falsifiable_prediction.observable: Frozen finite dependency sets, authority Booleans, explicit claim-state memberships, lineage edges and recalls, rational closed intervals, comparison directions, rational trajectory samples, and separately supplied release-state witnesses.
falsifiable_prediction.predicted: Every input satisfying the frozen premises satisfies all 22 contract conclusions, including strict common-parent loss, fail-closed authority, descendant recall, exact interval classification, transitive robust dominance, nonnegative trajectory measures, the adjacent-pair aftershock bound, and non-collapsing release states.
falsifiable_prediction.refuted_if: Lean accepts a concrete counterexample to any frozen theorem statement under the same definitions, or independent rebuild finds statement drift, a proof hole, a forbidden construct, a disallowed axiom, or a vacuous non-vacuity witness.

candidate_evidence.name: Governed Robustness Kernel v1 Certificates
candidate_evidence.nontrivial_justification: The package is a versioned successor to the earlier two-family robustness nucleus. It adds seven independently testable formal families and one cross-kernel witness: transitive recall over declared lineage, exact five-operator interval classification, a transitive separated-interval dominance order, nonnegative rational trajectory integrals and marked spans, a structural aftershock bound, and non-collapsing release states. No literature-priority claim is made, and elementary supporting lemmas are not promoted as standalone discoveries.
candidate_evidence.statement: A single frozen decision-kernel specification proves strict hidden-common-dependency loss, exact fail-closed execution authority, explicit epistemic-state separation, cascading content-addressed recall, complete disjoint closed-interval viability classification, transitive robust interval dominance, nonnegative sampled-trajectory shortfall and violation span, an adjacent-pair bound on aftershocks, and independent proof, selection, authorization, deployment, and observation witnesses.
candidate_evidence.witness: The release_states_are_independent_nonvacuous theorem constructs pairwise distinct proof, selection, authorization, deployment, and observation states. The robustness_kernel_v1_nonvacuous theorem simultaneously instantiates disjoint direct dependencies with a hidden shared parent, a valid authority lease and advisory denial, pass/fail/uncertain intervals, a strict robust-dominance pair, a nonzero trajectory shortfall, one aftershock, and recalled/descendant/unrelated lineage nodes.
